audit.why: Leona has no poke and needs to land E (Zenith Blade, 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s) to threaten anything; content's whys[0-3] already document that careful spacing keeps it even until her level-6 Solar Flare spike.

audit.why: Zenith Blade is 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s and drops fast with rank; Shield of Daybreak is a flat 5s empowered-auto reset — both concrete and worth stating.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now states real cooldowns and the auto-reset tell.
